name: antigravity-subagent
description: Delegate bounded tasks from Codex to Google Antigravity CLI through a skill or MCP tools.

interface.longDescription: Adds a guarded skill and local stdio MCP server for invoking Google Antigravity CLI in headless mode as an external second agent.
